review.why: Reviews a page or form for conversion problems and returns quick wins, high-impact changes, test ideas and copy alternatives.
review.summary: Asks for page type, goal and traffic source, then checks seven areas in order of impact: value proposition, headline, calls to action, hierarchy, trust signals, objections and friction. Output is quick wins, bigger changes, test ideas and copy options. Page-type notes and two references (form fixes, experiment ideas) go deeper.
strengths: Ordered by impact, so the highest-value fixes come first
Message match with the traffic source is checked
Hands off test design to a dedicated skill
cautions: Best practices, not tested on the user's own data
Form and experiment detail is in files not read here
No heatmap or analytics is read unless the user provides it
